Eligibility Criteria
Users must have been active before the snapshot on
July 8, 2023
.
Sybil attackers and accounts flagged for system abuse are ineligible.
Users can claim their rewards via the
Arkham Invite Dashboard
by entering their Ethereum address.
Only one address submission is allowed per user.
Airdrop allocation was based on platform usage
—users who engaged more with Arkham’s
Intelligence Platform
received more tokens.
Inviting users
to the platform was also a key factor in determining the number of tokens distributed.
